Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
Welcome to the Official Tim Hortons Music Program!
Your music player can be installed in just a few minutes.
Step 1 — Install Your Player
Unbox your PlayerOne device.
Connect it to power.
Connect it to your audio system.
Once connected, your player will automatically begin playing Tim Hortons-approved playlists.
Watch the Quick Setup Video

Step 2 — Connect Your Remote Control
You can manage your music from any phone, tablet, or computer.
Open the Tim Hortons Remote Control.
Click the + icon.
Enter your six-digit pairing code.
Select your location.
Your Pairing Code(s)
@RemoteCodeInfo2@
Watch the Remote Setup Video

Need Help?
Visit our Tim Hortons Music Support Center for:
Setup guides
Troubleshooting
FAQs
Video tutorials
Or contact us anytime:
THsupport@dm-us.com
Thank you,
